verdict.rationale: Godot ships a visual editor built around its Node and Scene system, which serves as scene composition and the prefab equivalent. EditorInterface documents saving and reloading scenes and inspecting and editing objects and resources, and the editor includes a FileSystem dock with drag-and-drop asset placement. The evidence for these pieces is thin and mostly indirect. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the 2D/3D viewport and level-building workflow, detailed coverage of the Inspector and scene instancing/inheritance as prefabs, and independent hands-on corroboration that the editor is the primary level-building tool.
